data.description:

Begeistern Sie sich für Technik? Wir auch! Zur Verstärkung unseres Expertenteams bei unserem Kunden aus der Funk- und Kommunikationsbranche suchen wir einen Senior Software Engineer C++/C# für verteilte Systeme (m/w/x) in Festanstellung bei K-tronik. Aufgaben:

  • Du konzipierst, entwickelst und optimierst Softwaremodule in C++ und C# innerhalb einer verteilten Systemlandschaft auf Windows- und Linux-Systemen.
  • Du implementierst leistungsfähige Kommunikationsschnittstellen, beispielsweise auf Basis von gRPC, und nutzt dabei moderne asynchrone Programmiermodelle.
  • Du entwickelst stabile und performante Anwendungen unter Einsatz von Multithreading und Concurrency-Konzepten.

Qualifikationen:

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Elektrotechnik oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung oder Ausbildung
  • Du verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit C++ und C#.

Auch in einem dynamischen Umfeld mit sich verändernden Anforderungen behältst Du den Überblick und gehst Herausforderungen lösungsorientiert an.

data.description:
Die websedit AG ist eine Full-Service Internetagentur mit Sitz in Ravensburg in der Bodensee Region. Wir gestalten und entwickeln anspruchsvolle Web-Lösungen für unsere Kunden. Für unser Team suchen wir Kolleginnen und Kollegen in der TYPO3-Entwicklung.

Deine Rolle

Wir entwickeln anspruchsvolle, skalierbare Websites und digitale Plattformen auf Basis von TYPO3. Dabei verbinden wir ein strukturiertes Figma-Designsystem mit modernen, KI-gestützten Entwicklungsprozessen.

Als Senior-TYPO3-Entwickler (m/w/d) übernimmst du die technische Verantwortung für unsere TYPO3-Architektur, entwickelst individuelle Extensions und stellst die Qualität unserer Implementierungen sicher. Gemeinsam mit Design und Entwicklung gestaltest du einen Workflow, in dem Figma und moderne Entwicklungswerkzeuge sinnvoll zusammenspielen.

KI betrachten wir dabei als Entwicklungswerkzeug: Wiederkehrende Aufgaben können automatisiert werden, während Architekturentscheidungen, fachliche Modellierung, Qualitätssicherung und technische Verantwortung bei erfahrenen Entwicklern bleiben.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige professionelle TYPO3-Erfahrung und sehr gute Kenntnisse in den im Unternehmen eingesetzten TYPO3-Versionen

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in PHP, objektorientierter Entwicklung, Fluid, TypoScript und Extbase

  • Erfahrung mit individuellen Extensions, sauberer Softwarearchitektur und wiederverwendbaren Komponenten

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Composer, Git und modernen Deployment-Prozessen

  • Erfahrung mit Datenmodellierung, Mehrsprachigkeit und redaktionellen Workflows

  • Kenntnisse in automatisierten Tests, Websicherheit und Performanceoptimierung

  • Eine eigenverantwortliche, strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie die Fähigkeit, technische Entscheidungen verständlich zu vermitteln und zu dokumentieren

  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie gute Englischkenntnisse für die technische Kommunikation und Dokumentation

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Linux, idealerweise Linux Mint oder einer vergleichbaren Linux-Distribution

Darüber freuen wir uns zusätzlich

  • Erfahrung mit Figma, Designsystemen, Design-Tokens und TYPO3 Content Blocks

  • Erfahrung mit KI-gestützten Entwicklungswerkzeugen; Kenntnisse von Codex oder dem Model Context Protocol (MCP) sind von Vorteil

  • Kenntnisse in Frontend-Frameworks, modernen CSS-Architekturen und visuellen Tests

  • Erfahrung mit Docker, Ansible und CI/CD-Systemen wie GitLab CI oder GitHub Actions

  • Kenntnisse in REST, GraphQL sowie Headless- oder Composable-Architekturen

Erfahrung mit diesen Werkzeugen ist kein Muss. Entscheidend sind deine Bereitschaft, neue Werkzeuge kritisch zu erproben, und dein Anspruch an hochwertige Software.

Benefits

Zahlreiche Benefits erwarten Dich:

  • Eine Internetagentur der ersten Stunde, gegründet 1997, mit Kunden aus der D-A-CH-Region

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten (Gleitzeit, keine Kernarbeitszeit) und Homeoffice für beste Work-Life-Balance

  • Ausgeprägte Teamarbeit in einem Alters-gemischten und engagierten Team

  • Entwicklung von SEA-Strategien: Gemeinsam mit unseren Account Managern arbeitest du zielgerichtete SEA-Strategien aus und sorgst dafür, dass das volle Werbepotenzial auf Amazon ausgeschöpft wird.

  • Amazon Seller Central: Du bist versiert im Umgang mit dem Amazon Seller Central und nutzt es zur Steuerung der Werbekampagnen.
  • PPC-Preisoptimierung: Du optimierst die PPC-Preise basierend auf vorher festgelegten Strategien und sorgst dafür, dass das Budget optimal eingesetzt wird.

Qualifikation

  • Studium: Du bist immatrikulierte/r Student/in.
  • Selbstständiges Arbeiten: Du bist in der Lage, eigenständig zu arbeiten und eigenverantwortlich Projekte zu steuern.
  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe: Du hast die Fähigkeit, dich schnell in neue Themengebiete einzuarbeiten und Lösungen zu finden.

  • Excel- und PowerPoint: Du hast sehr gute Kenntnisse in Excel und PowerPoint und weißt, wie man diese Tools effektiv einsetzt, um Ergebnisse zu präsentieren und Daten auszuwerten.

Benefits

  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Kombination aus Home Office und Arbeit im Büro, für mehr Flexibilität und Teamgeist.

  • Amazon-Design: Unterstützung bei der Erstellung von visuellen Inhalten für Amazon, einschließlich Produktbildern, A+ Content, Werbebannern und Infografiken zur Optimierung der Conversion-Rate.

Benefits

  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Kombination aus Home Office und Büroarbeit für mehr Flexibilität.

Senior Post Producer (m/w/d)

data.description:
Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place.

 

Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role

We're looking for a Senior Manager Strategic Finance to help lead DuckDuckGo's FP&A processes and strategic finance initiatives. You'll partner with cross-functional leadership on key decisions and evaluate the scale and profitability of new products, M&A and other strategic investments.

 

You'll build financial models for scenarios such as product expansion, search monetization, marketing ROI, and potential acquisitions. You'll review and summarize financial results and play a key role in quarterly forecasts (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) and annual and long-term planning. You'll also own recurring deliverables, including forecast variance, user metrics, P&L and headcount analyses. You'll help scale the team's processes, using AI tools like Claude and BI tools like Tableau and Grafana to make workflows more efficient.

 

We're a collaborative, transparent, self-motivated team. If our core values (build trust, question assumptions, and validate direction) resonate with you, you'll fit right in!

 

About You

  • 8+ years in strategic finance (FP&A, corporate development, investment banking, or consulting).

  • Advanced Excel and financial modeling, including three-statement forecasts.

  • Track record of owning complex, ambiguous analysis end to end and tying it to clear metrics.

  • Experience building working relationships with business partners and collaborating toward company objectives.

  • An instinct for automating recurring analysis, including with AI tools.

  • Clear, concise writing for senior leadership in a remote, async environment.

  • Dashboard experience: Tableau, Grafana, and Sage Intacct are a plus.

  • Sales finance, GTM, corporate finance, or M&A a plus.

  • U.S. GAAP accounting and reporting knowledge.

  • North America based.

  • Ad-based/subscription, technology, or public company experience a plus.

Compensation

$190,500 to $214,767 USD / $253,500 to $284,417 CAD annually and stock options. Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.

 

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

 

Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.

 

Hiring Process

Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire.

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

 

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to

 

Please note that:

  • You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing

  • Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.

  • While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.

  • A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.

  • By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.

 

Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process

As part of our commitment to enhancing our recruitment process, we utilize artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist in reviewing and summarizing job applications and test projects, including those tools integrated into our recruitment vendor platforms. We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process.

 

Key Principles:

  • Data Privacy: All information provided in your application will be handled in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Policy. We ensure that your personal information is protected and used solely for recruitment purposes.

  • Human Oversight and Accountability: The AI technology is designed to support our hiring team by providing insights and summaries of applications and evaluations of test projects against scoring rubrics. All final evaluations and hiring decisions, however, will be made by our hiring team, who will consider the AI's input alongside other factors.

  • Transparency: We believe in transparency regarding our hiring practices. If you have any questions about how AI is used in our recruitment process, please feel free to reach out to us.

 

By submitting your application, you acknowledge and consent to the use of AI technology in our review process. If you would like to request an alternative selection process, please contact us as at

data.description:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

More than 50 million people already use EverAI’s products, and we’re growing toward 100 million.

The audience is already here. The opportunity is what happens next.

We’re hiring a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager to take CRM to an entirely new level. Your mission is clear: turn it into a major revenue channel by converting more users, increasing repeat purchases, and giving people compelling reasons to keep coming back.

You’ll own everything within CRM, from onboarding and first purchase to retention and reactivation, across email, push notifications, in-product messaging, and promotions.

You’ll report directly to Thomas Lacroix, our Co-founder and CMO, with the freedom to rethink journeys, test ambitious ideas, and build the CRM playbook that gets us there.

At our scale, even small improvements can influence millions of user journeys and create significant growth.

About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

We are looking for a customer-oriented and results-driven candidate to join our Account Management Team. As a Senior Account Manager DACH at Perk, you will be actively contributing to our continued customer satisfaction as well as working to increase growth and margin within existing accounts.

Following our recent acquisition and rebranding, your role now encompasses our fully integrated Travel and Spend ecosystem. You will be responsible for a portfolio of large SMB accounts within the DACH market, helping them streamline not just their travel, but their entire expense management workflow. You must possess a genuine hunger to navigate your accounts in a fast-changing, hyper-growth environment, be ready to roll up your sleeves, and work hard.

What You Will Do:

  • Portfolio Management: Own a portfolio of large SMB customers and develop a high level of customer engagement with influential users (Admins, Finance Directors, Travel Managers) within those accounts.

  • Strategic Consultation: Gain a deep understanding of your customers' business and show you understand and identify with their goals as an organization. You will consult them on consolidating their financial stack by leveraging Perk’s unified Travel and Spend capabilities, identifying opportunities to optimize their expense reconciliation and cost control.

  • Product Expertise: Develop a deep understanding of the Perk portfolio of products—including our core Travel platform and our new Spend management solution. You will use this knowledge to guide customers through the benefits of an all-in-one T&E solution.

  • Expansion & Growth: Actively identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities for the Spend product within your existing book of business, driving adoption of corporate cards, automated invoice processing, and expense management features.

  • Problem Solving: Identify common problems within each account—whether related to bookings or expense workflows—and develop strategies to solve each issue in a timely manner whilst also developing foolproof methods to ensure repeat issues are a thing of the past.

  • Advocacy: Be Perk’s biggest advocate within your clients and your clients' biggest advocate within Perk. You’ll be the first one to address any issues, get support from our technical teams, and educate your clients on new product features across both Travel and Spend modules.

What We're Looking For

  • Minimum 2 years of relevant work experience within an Account Management or Customer Success role, preferably managing a portfolio of B2B clients.

  • Native or near-native proficiency in German.

  • Ability to speak and write in English fluently.

  • Experience in the Travel industry, Fintech, Expense Management, or SaaS products is highly desirable.

  • Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to explain complex integrations between travel bookings and financial reporting.

  • Customer-focused with a passion for working with people and solving financial pain points for businesses.

  • Excellent analytical abilities with fluency in Excel and data interpretation.

  • Solid analytical background to help clients visualise their T&E ROI.


You’ll Thrive Here If You Are:

  • A Trusted Collaborator: You care about collective team wins, foster transparent working relationships, and bring a straightforward, low-politics mindset to work.

  • Results-Driven: You know how to filter out noise and stay locked onto core objectives, taking full ownership of major milestones like key-account rollouts.

  • Feedback-Oriented: You view constructive feedback as a tool for growth, seeking input early, iterating fast, and sharing honest perspectives with your team.

  • A Strategic Client Partner: You naturally empathize with the financial and operational challenges our clients face, using those insights to build lasting, high-trust partnerships.

What We Offer

  • 30 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

  • Your choice of perk: a gym membership (Urban Sports Club) or a BVG public transport ticket.

  • Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

  • Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

  • Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Flexible compensation options to help your money go further.

  • 17 weeks of paid parental leave during your child’s first year.

  • 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

  • Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

  • A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

  • Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs.

 

Interview Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual

  • Hiring Manager Interview - 45mins Virtual

  • Assessment Interview - 60mins - Virtual

  • Values Interview - 30mins Virtual

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

You must possess a genuine hunger to navigate your accounts in a fast-changing, hyper-growth environment, be ready to roll up your sleeves, and work hard.

What You Will Do:

  • Portfolio Management: Own a portfolio of large SMB customers and develop a high level of customer engagement with influential users (Admins, Finance Directors, Travel Managers) within those accounts.

  • Strategic Consultation: Gain a deep understanding of your customers' business and show you understand and identify with their goals as an organization. You will consult them on consolidating their financial stack by leveraging Perk’s unified Travel and Spend capabilities, identifying opportunities to optimize their expense reconciliation and cost control.

  • Product Expertise: Develop a deep understanding of the Perk portfolio of products—including our core Travel platform and our new Spend management solution. You will use this knowledge to guide customers through the benefits of an all-in-one T&E solution.

What We're Looking For

  • Minimum 2 years of relevant work experience within an Account Management or Customer Success role, preferably managing a portfolio of B2B clients.

  • Native or near-native proficiency in German.

  • Ability to speak and write in English fluently.

  • Experience in the Travel industry, Fintech, Expense Management, or SaaS products is highly desirable.

  • Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to explain complex integrations between travel bookings and financial reporting.

  • Customer-focused with a passion for working with people and solving financial pain points for businesses.

  • Excellent analytical abilities with fluency in Excel and data interpretation.

  • Solid analytical background to help clients visualise their T&E ROI.


You’ll Thrive Here If You Are:

  • A Trusted Collaborator: You care about collective team wins, foster transparent working relationships, and bring a straightforward, low-politics mindset to work.

  • Results-Driven: You know how to filter out noise and stay locked onto core objectives, taking full ownership of major milestones like key-account rollouts.

  • Feedback-Oriented: You view constructive feedback as a tool for growth, seeking input early, iterating fast, and sharing honest perspectives with your team.

  • A Strategic Client Partner: You naturally empathize with the financial and operational challenges our clients face, using those insights to build lasting, high-trust partnerships.

What We Offer

  • 30 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

  • Your choice of perk: a gym membership (Urban Sports Club) or a BVG public transport ticket.

  • Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

  • Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

  • Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Flexible compensation options to help your money go further.

  • 17 weeks of paid parental leave during your child’s first year.

  • 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

  • Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

  • A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

Interview Process

  • Hiring Manager Interview - 45mins Virtual

  • Values Interview - 30mins Virtual

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters.   • Establish clear system boundaries and architectural direction without creating unnecessary central control.

  • Lead technical decisions by making constraints, alternatives, risks and trade-offs explicit.

  • Improve performance, resilience, data integrity, operability and failure handling across production systems.

  • Resolve recurring structural problems rather than treating symptoms team by team.

  • Remain hands-on where implementation, diagnosis or prototyping is the fastest way to create clarity.

  • Mentor senior engineers, raise review quality and make strong engineering judgement easier to reproduce across teams.

  • Partner with engineering and product leaders on sequencing, risk and long-term technical investment.

What you need to have

  • Evidence of technical impact across multiple teams or a substantial product domain.

  • Deep ownership of distributed backend systems operating at meaningful scale.

  • Strong judgement in service boundaries, asynchronous communication, data ownership, consistency and failure modes.

  • Deep knowledge of relational databases, transactions, concurrency and high-performance design.

  • A track record of improving reliability, scalability, observability or developer effectiveness through durable mechanisms.

WORUM ES GEHT

Du übernimmst die Finanzbuchhaltung von Thorit, hands-on und eigenständig. Zusammen mit unserem CFO bist du das Finance-Team: Du buchst selbst, hältst die Zahlen sauber und gestaltest mit, wie unsere Finanzprozesse künftig aussehen.

Wir sind eine AI-Beratung. Was wir bei unseren Kunden automatisieren, wollen wir auch intern umsetzen, und die Finanzbuchhaltung bietet sich dafür besonders an. Deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der sauber bucht und gleichzeitig Lust hat, Abläufe neu zu denken.

Heute liegt ein großer Teil der laufenden Buchhaltung noch bei unserer Steuerkanzlei. Langfristig wollen wir deutlich mehr davon selbst machen. In welchem Tempo und in welcher Reihenfolge, entscheidest du mit.

DEINE AUFGABEN

  • Du buchst eigenständig in DATEV: Kreditoren, Debitoren, Sachkonten und Bankabstimmung

  • Du räumst Altbestände auf und hältst die offenen Posten aktuell

  • Du bereitest den Monatsabschluss vor und machst daraus einen dokumentierten, wiederholbaren Prozess

  • Du sorgst für korrekte und fristgerechte Umsatzsteuervoranmeldungen

  • Du rechnest Reisekosten ab

  • Du bist Ansprechperson für unsere Steuerkanzlei und begleitest den Jahresabschluss

  • Du schaust dir unsere Abläufe kritisch an und automatisierst, was sinnvoll ist, zum Beispiel Belegzuordnung, Abstimmungen oder Auswertungen

  • Du übernimmst Schritt für Schritt Aufgaben, die heute noch extern laufen

  • Du dokumentierst unsere Finance-Prozesse in Confluence

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

Notwendig

  • Mehrjährige Praxis in der deutschen Finanzbuchhaltung, sodass du im Tagesgeschäft ohne lange Einarbeitung loslegen kannst

  • Sicherer Umgang mit DATEV

  • Solides Wissen im Handels- und Steuerrecht, soweit es die Buchhaltung betrifft

  • Du arbeitest gern eigenständig und triffst Entscheidungen, auch wenn niemand danebensteht

  • Du bist neugierig und eignest dir neue Themen schnell selbst an

  • Du interessierst dich für Digitalisierung und AI und willst dich darin weiterentwickeln. Programmierkenntnisse brauchst du nicht.

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch für den Arbeitsalltag (unsere Unternehmenssprache ist Englisch, ein Teil des Teams sitzt in Lissabon)

  • Du wohnst im Raum Böblingen und bist regelmäßig im Büro

Schön zu haben

  • Erste Erfahrung mit Automatisierung in der Buchhaltung, etwa Bankregeln, Belegmatching, Schnittstellen oder AI-Tools

  • Erfahrung mit DATEV Lohn und Gehalt (die Abrechnung läuft aktuell extern, ist aber perspektivisch ein Thema)

  • Erfahrung mit Jahresabschlüssen zusammen mit einer externen Kanzlei

  • Weiterbildung zum Bilanzbuchhalter (abgeschlossen oder geplant)

UNSER SETUP

  • WeClapp als führendes System für Rechnungsausgang, Eingangsrechnungen und offene Posten

  • DATEV für die Buchhaltung und den Austausch mit der Kanzlei

  • Qonto für Kontoanbindung und Belegmatching mit DATEV-Schnittstelle

  • TravelPerk für Reisebuchungen

  • Confluence für Dokumentation, Forecast für Zeiterfassung, HubSpot als CRM

  • Claude ist bei uns Standardwerkzeug. Es ersetzt keine Buchhaltung, nimmt dir aber Recherche, Dokumentation und wiederkehrende Fleißarbeit ab.

WAS WIR DIR ZUSAGEN

  • Alle Zugriffe ab Tag 1: Bankvollmachten, System- und Leserechte

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem CFO und kurze Wege zur Geschäftsführung

  • Echten Gestaltungsspielraum: Du baust Finance mit auf, statt ein fertiges System zu verwalten

  • Zeit, um Automatisierungen auszuprobieren und dich in AI weiterzubilden

RAHMENBEDINGUNGEN

  • Standort: Böblingen, mindestens 2 Bürotage pro Woche

  • Umfang: Vollzeit oder Teilzeit ab 25 Std./Woche

  • Start: ab sofort

Was wir bieten

  • Vorsorge & Zuschüsse: Betriebliche Altersvorsorge über die Allianz mit gestaffeltem Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 50 bis 290 € monatlich, dazu Lunchit-Essenszuschuss von bis zu 100 € monatlich

  • Flexibilität: Bis zu 4 Wochen pro Jahr Arbeiten von überall in der EU inklusive 500 € Zuschuss, Spaces-Coworking-Mitgliedschaft, flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • Gesundheit & Mobilität: Business Bike Leasing, Urban Sports Club mit Zugang zu über 8.000 Standorten

  • Weiterbildung: Vollzugriff auf die Blinkist-Business-Bibliothek (4.500+ Titel), 3 Monate Babbel, vollständig finanzierte HubSpot-Zertifizierungen

  • Kultur: Flache Hierarchien mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung, moderner Toolstack, Corporate Benefits bei über 800 Marken

Über Thorit

Thorit ist die AI- und CRM-Beratung für das agentische Unternehmen. Als Diamond HubSpot Partner arbeiten wir mit B2B-Kunden im DACH-Markt: Wir bauen die Agenten-Ebene auf HubSpot und den umliegenden Systemen auf – und betreiben sie gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden. Was wir dort empfehlen, wenden wir auch intern an: weniger Handarbeit, mehr Struktur. Diese Rolle ist ein zentraler Teil davon.

Bewerbung

Schick uns deine Bewerbung – Lebenslauf reicht, ein Anschreiben ist optional.

Wenn du magst, schreib uns ein paar Sätze dazu, wie du schon einmal eine unaufgeräumte Buchhaltung in Ordnung gebracht hast. Das interessiert uns mehr als jede Formulierung im Anschreiben – wir fragen sonst im Gespräch danach.

About Yepoda

Clean K-Beauty Innovation. No compromises.

Yepoda is a clean K-Beauty brand that actually proves it works. We make Korean skincare without any of the compromises. Everything is clinically tested, 100% vegan, and formulated above EU standards. So you get the innovation and the results that K-Beauty is known for, plus a real commitment to sustainability. And we make it genuinely fun and easy to use — skincare you actually look forward to.

Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a certified B Corp™ and 1% for the Planet member, based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available through our own online shop and, since March 2025, at Sephora Europe — online and in over 650 stores. With a team of 140+ brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda's story every day.

As Campaign Manager, you are an excellent project manager with an advertising and commercial marketing background. You bring the selling message into every campaign from day one, work closely with our Brand team, and get campaigns live across all channels and markets.

Your tasks

  • Turn each campaign on the commercial calendar into one plan: campaign page, owners and deadlines

  • Run kickoffs and drive every milestone through to go-live in all markets

  • Manage our marketing channel stakeholders (Influencer, CRM, Performance Marketing, Social Media, Website and Creative), keep everyone on the same brief and dates, and escalate early

  • Deliver postmortems with revenue against target and clear learnings per channel for the next campaign

  • Start from the commercial goal of each campaign and build concept routes aligned with the Brand team

  • Push concepts from brand storytelling toward advertising: a clear hook, a single benefit and a reason to buy now

  • Propose hero products, gifts with purchase, bundles and minimum order values by market, backed by past performance data and expected uplift

  • Bring in market trends, competitor promotions and cultural moments to sharpen every campaign

Your profile

  • 3–5 years in advertising (account or strategy side), or in growth or campaign marketing at a D2C brand. You know what makes a campaign convert

  • You can write and judge headlines, hooks and CTAs

  • You have delivered multi-channel, multi-market campaigns on time and can show the plans behind them

  • You work well with Brand and Creative teams, hold the commercial line without friction, and align people you don’t manage

  • You think in revenue, sell-through, AOV and margin, and can argue why one offer beats another

  • You take ownership, bring solutions and keep process light

  • Fluent English; a second EU language is a plus

  • Beauty or D2C experience is a plus

What We Offer

  • Dynamic Environment: The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team.

  • Accelerate Your Career: Take on responsibility from day 1, with room for professional growth and advancement as the company continues to expand.

  • Inspiring Workspace: Located in the heart of Berlin's Prenzlauer Berg, a dog-friendly office, with free drinks and snacks.

  • Hybrid Working: We understand that sometimes you get more stuff done from home and need a change of scenery.

  • We Value Diversity: We seek to build an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from all different backgrounds. A welcoming, international, dedicated team with flat hierarchies and trust by default.

  • Employee Discounts: You’ll get to enjoy the Yepoda products at a discount and share it with friends and family to keep your glow going!

  • Unique Add Ons: A monthly benefits budget that's yours to spend. Through the Probonio app you pick what actually fits your lifestyle.

Would you like to be part of the team? Then we'd love to hear from you! 🫰✨

Make sure to apply by clicking on the “Apply for this job” button below. Please upload your CV and Cover Letter in English language. Our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get back to you as soon as possible.

At Yepoda we are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals, regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, citizenship, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, parental status, disability, or any other status protected by applicable law.

About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

 

The Role

As a Graphene Photonics Data Analyst, you will transform complex characterization data into reliable insights that guide device design, process development, and manufacturing decisions. You will own and evolve our analysis software, develop new methods for emerging experiments, and help scale our analytical capabilities as we transition from R&D to high-volume production.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Own and continuously improve our characterization analysis software suite

  • Develop new analysis methods as experiments and measurement capabilities evolve

  • Handle large measurement datasets spanning electrical, optical, and electro-optical characterization

  • Ensure the integrity, accuracy, and traceability of analysis outputs

  • Turn raw measurement data into actionable insights for process and design decisions

  • Extract device parameters from measured data and benchmark results against physical and compact models

  • Perform statistical process and yield analyses to identify trends, correlations, and outliers across wafers and lots

  • Correlate characterization results with process parameters, closing the loop between measurement and process control

  • Integrate analysis outputs with fab MES and data systems to enable real-time process feedback

  • Define standardized analysis protocols and transition mature R&D code into robust, production-ready tools

  • Optimize analysis pipelines for throughput and scalability as we move toward high-volume production

Your Qualifications

  • An M.S. or PhD in Data Science, Physics, or another relevant technical discipline

  • At least two years of relevant industry or research experience; a related PhD project

  • Strong Python skills and a genuine passion for building high-quality software

  • A proven track record of designing, developing, and owning a software pipeline or technical project end-to-end

  • A solid foundation in device physics, including solid-state physics, semiconductor devices, and photonics

  • Experience with statistical analysis, model fitting, and parameter extraction

  • Experience with data visualization and tracking trends across wafers, lots, or manufacturing processes

  • The ability to work with laboratory or fab instrument interfaces

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

 

Can you picture yourself in this Role and our Company? Let’s connect!

Wir suchen einen motivierten Account Executive für unser wachsendes Account Executive-Team. Dies ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, den Sales Cycle in einem dynamischen, stark wachsenden ConTech-Unternehmen eigenverantwortlich zu übernehmen. Du wirst maßgeblich dazu beitragen, unsere Marktreichweite mit einem KI-gestützten Produkt auszubauen, das bereits einen bedeutenden Umsatztreiber darstellt.

Tätigkeiten

  • Verantwortest den gesamten Sales Cycle, inklusive Zuarbeit von SDR's für SMB-Kunden – von der Akquise bis zum Abschluss.

  • Steuerst Multi-Stakeholder-Beziehungen und stehst im Austausch mit Ansprechpartnern von Geschäftsführern bis hin zu CFOs und Einkaufsleitern.

  • Setzt ausgeprägte Deal-Orchestrierungs-Fähigkeiten ein, um komplexe Buying Center zu navigieren.

  • Gibst strukturiertes Marktfeedback an die Produktteams weiter.

  • Arbeitest direkt mit dem VP Sales und CEO an der Deal-Strategie zusammen.

Team

Du wirst Teil eines Teams von 5 Account Executives und damit der 6. SMB-AE. Wir arbeiten mit einem Verhältnis von 2 SDRs pro AE. Zu Beginn sind AEs für die ersten Monate für den Aufbau ihrer eigenen Pipeline selbst verantwortlich, um ein tiefes Marktverständnis zu entwickeln, bevor sie – leistungsabhängig – SDR-Unterstützung erhalten. Du hast eine direkte Verbindung zum VP Sales und CEO für die Deal-Strategie.

Berufserfahrung

  • Für Midlevel-Positionen: 2+ Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Closing mit High-Velocity-Deals und mehreren Stakeholdern.

  • Für Senior-Positionen: 3+ Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Closing mit High-Velocity-Deals.

  • Nachweisliche Erfolge bei Deals mit einem ACV von 12.000 € oder mehr.

  • Ausgeprägte Outbound-Erfahrung, einschließlich Prospecting, Pipeline-Aufbau und Kaltakquise.

  • Fähigkeit, C-Level-Entscheider (Geschäftsführer, CFOs, Einkauf) zu überzeugen und zu beeinflussen.

  • Hohe Eigenmotivation, Resilienz und die Fähigkeit, in einem wettbewerbsintensiven Umfeld zu bestehen.

  • Teamplayer mit einer kollaborativen Denkweise.

Cosuno – Wir revolutionieren die Baubranche durch Technologie.

Wir sind Cosuno – ein schnell wachsendes Tech-Startup, das die Baubranche mit unserer digitalen Plattform für Ausschreibungs- und Vergabeprozesse effizienter und transparenter macht. Unser Ziel: Die komplexesten Herausforderungen der Branche mit Innovation und Einfachheit zu lösen.

Warum Cosuno?
Künstliche Intelligenz ist der Schlüssel zu unserer Lösung: Sie analysiert Millionen von Preisdatenpunkten und hilft Bauunternehmen dabei, präzise und effiziente Angebote zu erstellen. Das spart nicht nur Zeit, sondern vermeidet auch unnötige Kosten.

Doch für uns geht es nicht nur um Technologie – sondern vor allem um die Menschen, die sie vorantreiben. Bei Cosuno arbeitest du mit kreativen Köpfen zusammen, die die Baubranche neu denken. Wir glauben an Vielfalt, denn die besten Ideen entstehen durch unterschiedliche Perspektiven. Eine integrative und inklusive Arbeitsumgebung ist für uns selbstverständlich.


Werde Teil von Cosuno – gestalte die Zukunft des Bauens mit uns.

data.title: Mobiler Ausbilder für Wärmepumpen (w/m/d)

data.description:
Your Impact

Tacto is the category leader for procurement in DACH manufacturing. We have strong product-market fit, a proven playbook, and now we're taking it into the rest of Europe.

Benelux is one of our first markets. The Netherlands and Belgium hold a dense base of high-tech and industrial manufacturers, and the category is still wide open there. That's where you come in. You take the region and build it from the ground up. You research the market, find what resonates, and win the first customers and reference logos that everything else builds on. What you learn becomes the blueprint for how Tacto grows Benelux from there. A real greenfield, with the freedom to shape how Tacto wins in your market.

You're not starting alone. A stellar expansion team is your sparring partner, and proven sales assets and a tested approach from DACH are your foundation. This is a highly strategic GTM role where you work hands-on to close the first deals and set the base for everything that comes afterwards. You're based with us in Munich and travel into your market.

Your Tasks

  • Open up Benelux end to end: sharpen the ICP for Dutch and Belgian manufacturing, define target accounts, win the first deals and lay the foundation for the region's growth

  • Run the full sales cycle: discovery, demo, potential analysis on real ERP data, ROI business case, closing

  • Work hand in hand with the expansion team and develop the outbound playbook for your market: messaging, sequences, segments, channels

  • Coordinate the marketing activities in your market so they generate pipeline

  • Feed structured insight back to Product, Marketing and Leadership, and shape how Tacto expands internationally

Your Profile

  • Several years of full-cycle closing experience in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex or technical products and multi-stakeholder buying processes

  • An entrepreneurial mindset above all: you want to build and own a market result, explore what works, and figure out the motion when the local one doesn't exist yet

  • Hands-on and self-driven: you go to market proactively and drive your own pipeline. You've carried a number before and know what it takes to hit it without a machine behind you

  • You grasp complex products and sell value over features, translating technical depth into business impact

  • Fluent, business-level English. Dutch is a strong plus, French an advantage for the Belgian market. We hire for mindset and ability, not origin or native language

  • You're based in Munich or ready to relocate. This is an on-site role - you build Benelux from our Munich office and travel into the market

Who Thrives Here

You run your market like a founder runs a company. You're a hunter, hands-on to the core: you send the first cold emails, run the first discoveries, and do the early, unglamorous work where real traction is won. You go through the mud and build as you go, turning what works into a system the next person can run. And you think beyond the next deal. You're not just winning customers, you're laying Tacto's foundation in your region: externally through brand, network, and reference logos, and internally through the playbook and the case for the market.

Interview Process

  1. Intro call with our Chief of Staff

  2. Deep dive with our Head of Revenue

  3. Get-to-know call with the AE you'd be working alongside

  4. Onsite interview incl. case study and team meetings

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

  • Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

  • Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

  • Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

  • Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

  • Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

  • Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

The Nordics are one of our first markets. Sweden, Denmark, Norway and Finland hold some of Europe's most sophisticated industrial manufacturers, and the category is still wide open there. That's where you come in. You take the region and build it from the ground up. You research the market, find what resonates, and win the first customers and reference logos that everything else builds on. What you learn becomes the blueprint for how Tacto grows the Nordics from there. A real greenfield, with the freedom to shape how Tacto wins in your market.

You're not starting alone. A stellar expansion team is your sparring partner, and proven sales assets and a tested approach from DACH are your foundation. This is a highly strategic GTM role where you work hands-on to close the first deals and set the base for everything that comes afterwards. You're based with us in Munich and travel into your market.

Your Tasks

  • Open up the Nordics end to end: sharpen the ICP for Nordic manufacturing, define target accounts, win the first deals and lay the foundation for the region's growth

  • Run the full sales cycle: discovery, demo, potential analysis on real ERP data, ROI business case, closing

  • Work hand in hand with the expansion team and develop the outbound playbook for your market: messaging, sequences, segments, channels

  • Coordinate the marketing activities in your market so they generate pipeline

  • Feed structured insight back to Product, Marketing and Leadership, and shape how Tacto expands internationally

Your Profile

  • Several years of full-cycle closing experience in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex or technical products and multi-stakeholder buying processes

  • An entrepreneurial mindset above all: you want to build and own a market result, explore what works, and figure out the motion when the local one doesn't exist yet

  • Hands-on and self-driven: you go to market proactively and drive your own pipeline. You've carried a number before and know what it takes to hit it without a machine behind you

  • You grasp complex products and sell value over features, translating technical depth into business impact

  • Fluent, business-level English. Swedish, Danish, Norwegian or Finnish is a strong plus. We hire for mindset and ability, not origin or native language

  • You're based in Munich or ready to relocate. This is an on-site role - you build the Nordics from our Munich office and travel into the market

Who Thrives Here

You run your market like a founder runs a company. You're a hunter, hands-on to the core: you send the first cold emails, run the first discoveries, and do the early, unglamorous work where real traction is won. You go through the mud and build as you go, turning what works into a system the next person can run. And you think beyond the next deal. You're not just winning customers, you're laying Tacto's foundation in your region: externally through brand, network, and reference logos, and internally through the playbook and the case for the market.

Interview Process

  1. Intro call with our Chief of Staff

  2. Deep dive with our Head of Revenue

  3. Get-to-know call with the AE you'd be working alongside

  4. Onsite interview incl. case study and team meetings

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

  • Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

  • Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

  • Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

  • Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

  • Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

  • Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Unzer is a leading European fintech company with a mission to simplify international payments for e-commerce and retail businesses. Our brand was formed from 13 companies that now contribute to building a unique product covering the entire payment flow.

We are a team of over 700 experts of 55 different nationalities, dedicated to creating a state-of-the-art unified commerce platform. Whether you're a tech enthusiast, payment expert, or a dedicated support professional, we are looking for individuals who are passionate about making a difference.  
 
Our offices: We are based across Austria, Denmark, Germany and Luxembourg with a HQ in Berlin.

Unzer's POS department is the commercial engine connecting Unzer's terminal technology to merchants across Europe — spanning Field & Inside Sales, Merchant Services, Onboarding, Technical Support, and Sales Strategy. Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place!
 
E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of space-powered Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are fundamentally changing the design, economics, manufacturing, coverage limitations and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems.
 
By building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system—with a unique antenna design, highly sustainable spacecraft system and low-cost, small portable end-user devices—we can extend global satellite coverage, capacity and connectivity beyond legacy space services to provide a new kind of IoT platform that lets users sense, track, connect and act on information gathered, anywhere.
 
We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to saving space, protecting our planet and turning connectivity into actionable intelligence.

As a Senior Software Engineer focused on the 5G Physical Layer, you will lead the design, implementation, optimization, and integration of 5G NR PHY software for 3GPP Release 15/16/17 and beyond-5G systems. Your work will focus on real-time, performance-critical PHY algorithms running on processor- and accelerator-based platforms, with close interaction with RF, DSP, and hardware teams.
This role emphasizes PHY algorithm implementation, real-time constraints, and RF/SoC integration, while supporting higher-layer interfaces as needed. The position is based in Duisburg, Germany.

What you will do
  • 5G PHY Software Design and Implementation
  • Design, implement, and optimize 5G NR PHY algorithms on processor-based and heterogeneous SoC platforms
  • Develop software for key PHY functions such as modulation/demodulation, channel estimation, equalization, synchronization, coding/decoding, and HARQ support
  • Implement PHY software compliant with 3GPP Rel 15/16/17 specifications
    •  
  • Hardware, RF, and Platform Integration
  • Integrate 5G PHY software with RF front-end hardware and digital baseband chains
  • Develop and maintain hardware control software using interfaces such as I2C and SPI
  • Work with complex SoC architectures, including ARM, DSPs, and hardware accelerators
  • Develop software interfaces toward embedded accelerators and DSP blocks
    •  
  • Real-Time and Embedded Systems
  • Design software within strict real-time constraints and low-latency requirements
  • Develop on embedded Linux, DSP operating systems, and lightweight RTOS such as FreeRTOS and Zephyr
  • Optimize performance, memory usage, and throughput of PHY software components
    •  
  • Verification, Testing, and Debug
  • Create and execute PHY-level test cases and validation scenarios
  • Generate, analyze, and verify PHY test vectors and waveforms
  • Verify PHY functionality using 5G test equipment (e.g., R&S, Agilent) and commercial UEs
  • Debug complex PHY, timing, RF, and performance issues across software and hardware boundaries
    •  
  • Technical Leadership and Delivery
  • Provide effort estimation and technical input for PHY software development tasks
  • Support customer requests related to 5G PHY features and performance
  • Document PHY designs, implementations, and results in Confluence or equivalent systems
    •  
  • Collaboration and Ways of Working
  • Collaborate with RF, systems, hardware, and protocol stack teams to ensure clean PHY-MAC interfaces
  • Work effectively in a global, distributed team across Europe, India, and the U.S.
  • Follow SCRUM / Agile and Continuous Integration development practices
  • Operate autonomously while maintaining strong technical communication

    • What you bring to this role
  • Master of Science or Master of Engineering degree in Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, or equivalent
  • Significant professional experience as an embedded C and C/C++ software engineer
  • Strong background in 5G NR PHY and digital communications theory
  • Experience working with SDR platforms and SoC architectures
  • Working knowledge of MATLAB and Python for PHY algorithm development and analysis
  • Strong understanding of real-time embedded software constraints
  • Excellent problem-solving, time management, and communication skills

    • Bonus Points
  • Deep understanding of 3GPP 5G NR PHY specifications (Rel 15/16/17+)
  • Experience with Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) and satellite communications
  • Experience implementing PHY algorithms on DSPs and hardware accelerators
  • Strong understanding of link budgets, channel models, and RF impairments
  • Experience with waveform generation, PHY simulation, and lab bring-up

    • Additional Requirements
    This is a fast-paced, high-impact environment - flexibility to occasionally work extended hours or weekends during critical periods is expected.
    At E-Space, you’ll work on cutting-edge PHY software that sits at the heart of next-generation wireless and satellite communication systems. We offer a collaborative environment, competitive compensation, and opportunities to make a real technical impact on global connectivity.

    Why E-Space is right for you:

    We want you to make the most of your journey at E-Space. That’s why we support and invest in the physical, emotional and financial well-being of our team members and their families. Some of what you can expect when working at E-Space:

    • Sustainability at our core
    • Fair and honest workplace
    • Innovative thinking is encouraged
    • Competitive salaries
    • Continuous learning and development
    • Health and wellness care options
    • Financial solutions for the future

What you can expect from us

Career Path 
Your professional development is important to us, so we have laid out a career plan to help you progress towards your goals and objectives. 
 
Relocation Support 
We offer a relocation budget and full coverage of flights to Frankfurt for you and your family.

Company Apartment

Public Transport Pass

Gym Card 
A healthy body is a healthy mind. We offer a membership at the premium gym chain Fitness First in Germany. Work out, join group fitness classes, or relax in the wellness facilities.

German Classes

Events
Join us on our exciting company events, including new starter breakfasts, summer and winter parties, our annual trip to Gamescom in Cologne, and many more!
 
Vacation Days 
At our Frankfurt office you can enjoy 24 days of vacation per year, and every 2 years you get 1 more (up to a maximum of 28 days). You will also have on average 10 public holidays on top of the days you take off.

At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀

Engagement Management is a new and fast-growing practice at ClickUp, and it's quickly becoming central to how we serve our enterprise customers. Our EMs bring program leadership, service delivery and change management together in one role. As a ClickUp Senior Engagement Manager you will lead the formation and orchestration of post-sale strategy and execution for the company’s largest and most strategic clients. We're looking for someone hungry, who excels in building, and who takes genuine pride in the quality of their work.

Here, Engagement Managers are the single point of accountability for outcomes. You own everything between the contract being signed and the client seeing measurable results: what was sold gets delivered, on time and on margin, and we can prove it worked.

You'll lead enterprise SaaS implementations across the full engagement lifecycle, from shaping scope in pre-sales, mobilizing the team and delivery, go-live, stabilization and a clean handover to the account team. You'll run work-stream programs with Paid TAMs, AI specialists, Product and Engineering, and the client's own project team, and you'll be the trusted advisor to the client's executive sponsor.

 

Simply put: you are the single point of accountability for delivery, the client's partner in getting value from ClickUp, and a thought leader for how we deliver.

 

Your role

  • Stakeholder Management

    • Serve as the primary client contact for delivery

    • Build strong relationships with stakeholders while ensuring delivery remains aligned to client objectives and contractual commitments.

    • Build trusted relationships with client executive sponsors and program leads at VP and C-level, acting as their primary point of contact for delivery.

    • Navigate complex enterprise stakeholder environments and competing priorities across client functions (IT, PMO, business sponsors, procurement) and broker alignment when they conflict.

  • Project Delivery Oversight

    • Deliver engagements against agreed scope, schedule, hours budget and quality, using rigorous change control to protect timelines and delivery margin.

    • Translate customer business requirements into internal deliverables and milestones

    • Own engagement governance, including kickoffs, weekly working sessions, sponsor check-ins and SteerCos, and provide clear, concise status reporting to clients and internal stakeholders.

    • Lead and coordinate multidisciplinary teams, fostering a collaborative, accountable and high-performing delivery culture while providing coaching, direction and support.

    • Proactively manage risks, issues and dependencies through the RAID log, and act as the primary escalation point.

    • Manage engagement financials, including hours burn, forecasting, utilisation and margin, flagging overrun risk early and agreeing recovery plans.

  • Drive AI adoption

    • Guide clients from manual workflows to AI-assisted and agent-driven operations, and own post-go-live adoption outcomes.

  • Drive Value and Business Outcomes

    • Identify expansion opportunities through delivery and co-sell with Account Executives, bringing the delivery credibility that secures follow-on work.

    • Establish a value baseline before configuration begins, track benefits through go-live, and produce the value assessment that underpins renewal and expansion.

  • Governance

    • Design and run governance mechanisms

    • Track delivery efficacy, timelines, value realization and customer experience

    • Create continuous-improvement mechanisms

  • Change Management & Communication

    • Own communications around delivery status, risks and outcomes

    • Manage escalation and communication across customer/internal teams

    • Assess change readiness and resistance across impacted teams; build sponsor and champion networks to carry the rollout.

    • Design the communications and enablement plan with the client, and sequence go-live to match the organization's capacity for change.

  • Role Development

    • Contribute to building the Engagement Management practice by iterating on templates, playbooks and AI workflows that make every engagement faster and more consistent.

 

Your skills and experience

  • 5+ years of software and/or services delivery experience, with at least 2 years as the accountable project, program or engagement lead.

  • Proven track record taking enterprise SaaS deployments from kickoff through go-live and into adoption, ideally in work management, PSA, CRM, ITSM or collaboration platforms.

  • Strong grasp of SaaS implementation fundamentals: workspace and data architecture, permissions and SSO, integrations, data migration, change management and enablement. No coding required, but you can challenge an unrealistic technical scope.

Worum gehts?

Bei Event Inc wollen wir Entscheidungen konsequent auf Basis von Daten treffen. Das gilt von der Go-to-Market-Strategie bis zur Conversion-Optimierung, in Marketing, Sales und Product. Mit Dir bündeln wir die Analysekompetenz an einer Stelle und schaffen eine gemeinsame Datenbasis, auf die sich alle verlassen können.

Deine Rolle

Als Data Analyst (Mensch) mit dem Schwerpunkt Go-to-Market & Insights bist Du die zentrale Anlaufstelle für Datenanalysen entlang unserer gesamten Wertschöpfungskette. Du bist Teil unseres Product Teams und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit unseren Data Engineers. Du begleitest Maßnahmen von der ersten Exploration über die Empfehlung bis zur Wirkungsmessung.

  • Performance im Blick: Du überwachst laufend unsere GTM-Performance über Marketing, Sales und Product hinweg, von Funnel-Analysen über Kanal-Performance bis zu Conversion-Raten.
  • Zahlen, die etwas bewegen: Du lieferst Ad-hoc-Analysen für unsere Teams, immer mit konkreten Handlungsempfehlungen statt reinen Reports.
  • Von der Idee bis zur Wirkung: Gemeinsam mit den Teams entwickelst Du Hypothesen und übersetzt sie in Experimente und A/B-Tests. Mit Vorher-/Nachher-Vergleichen misst Du, ob Maßnahmen wirklich wirken.
  • Muster erkennen: Du machst Cohort- und Funnel-Analysen über Kundensegmente und Marketplace-Bereiche hinweg (z. B. Pharma vs. Automotive). Mit Win/Loss-Analysen bei Enterprise-Deals lieferst Du wertvollen Input für unser Sales Enablement.
  • Traffic-Kanäle optimieren: In enger Abstimmung mit Marketing, Sales und Product optimierst Du unsere Traffic-Kanäle, z. B. mit Blick auf SEO/GEO-Performance und Content-Wirkung.
  • Reporting smart automatisieren: Zusammen mit einem Data Engineer baust Du eine KI- und automatisierungsgestützte Reporting-Infrastruktur auf. So fließt Deine Zeit in Analyse und Empfehlung statt in manuelle Datenaufbereitung.
  • Schnittstelle mit Gewicht: Du bist die zentrale Datenquelle für GTM-Entscheidungen und arbeitest direkt mit unserem CPO zusammen.

Was uns gefällt

  • Fundierte Basis: Du hast ein Studium oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung in Data Science, Statistik, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Mathematik, BWL oder einem ähnlichen Bereich erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
  • Erfahrung, die zählt: Du bringst 2–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Data, Business oder Product Analytics mit. Mit Marketing-, Sales- oder Marketplace-Funnel-Metriken und Tracking kennst Du Dich aus.
  • Analytisches Handwerkszeug: Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse in Datenanalyse und Statistik und weißt, wie man aussagekräftige KPIs entwickelt.
  • Daten in Klartext: Du leitest aus Zahlen konkrete, verständliche Empfehlungen ab und vermittelst sie so, dass jedes Team etwas damit anfangen kann.
  • Struktur, auch wenn's voll wird: Du arbeitest eigenständig und behältst den Überblick, auch wenn mehrere Teams gleichzeitig etwas von Dir brauchen.
  • Tech-Neugier: Du verstehst Code und schreibst ihn auch selbst (z. B. Python). Idealerweise hast Du schon mit Coding Agents Analysen erstellt oder automatisierte, KI-gestützte Reportings aufgebaut. Das ist kein Muss, aber ein großes Plus.

Was Dir gefällt

  • Teamspirit, der Spaß macht: Freu Dich auf ein motiviertes, hochqualifiziertes Team mit flachen Hierarchien und echtem Zusammenhalt. Dazu gibt's regelmäßige Teamevents wie Afterwork-Drinks auf der Dachterrasse, Culture Nights oder Spieleabende.
  • Sei ein Sparfuchs: Profitiere von exklusiven Rabatten auf Top-Marken und Reisen über PepXpress und Corporate Benefits.
  • Gut versorgt: Natürlich stehen Dir der obligatorische Obstkorb, eine Müslibar sowie kalte und warme Getränke jederzeit zur Verfügung.
  • Individuelle Hardware-Wahl: Du entscheidest, ob Du mit einem Mac oder einem Windows-Gerät arbeitest.

  • We celebrate our successes together! Whether at the summer party, a BBQ evening on our rooftop terrace, or just because
  • A nest in Berlin: a rooftop terrace overlooking Berlin-Kreuzberg and our office dogs, who are already looking forward to meeting you

Among other tasks you will be working on

  • Strategic Leadership & Organization: You will lead our entire engineering team

  • Collaborate closely with the CEO, Product, Go-To-Market, and other key stakeholders on strategic planning, prioritization, and company-wide decision-making
  • Manage the engineering budget, workforce planning, and external vendor/outsourcing strategy – aligning costs, capacity, and business value

What you bring along for this role

  • 5+ years of proven experience leading a larger and technically diverse engineering organization – ideally in a fintech environment or SaaS company, with a track record of actively developing internal talent into senior and leadership roles
  • Strong background in infrastructure design and implementation, combined with end-to-end system architecture experience across production environments, ensuring systems are scalable, resilient, performant, and able to serve customers efficiently at scale.
  • Technical understanding of modern software architectures and software development processes
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and comprehensively to non-technical stakeholders
  • Tech & AI affinity: Keen interest in modern engineering tools, automation, and AI-supported workflows
  • Keeping up with technology trends in SaaS and Payments areas
  • Business-fluent English skills, both spoken and written

Technology experience across several of the following areas:

  • Mobile: iOS and Android, including Objective-C, Swift, and Kotlin Multiplatform
  • Backend & Web: Python, Java, Django, React, PostgreSQL, and Redis
