Notre client est une TPE basée au nord de Lyon, spécialisée dans les énergies du sous-sol : pétrole, gaz, géothermie et stockage de CO2. Son activité repose entièrement sur la R&D : essais sur géomatériaux, géomécanique et développement d'équipements d'essais pour des clients internationaux.

Son équipe pluridisciplinaire et multiculturelle développe des solutions technologiques innovantes au service de l'efficacité, de la protection de l'environnement et de la maîtrise des coûts. L'entreprise est certifiée ISO 9001 et toutes ses activités respectent sa démarche QHSE.

Le poste

Pour accélérer ses projets de développement, notre client recrute un(e) Ingénieur(e) R&D en conception d'équipements d'essais.  Vous prendrez en charge la conception, la mise au point et la validation de cellules d'essais haute température et haute pression, un sujet stratégique pour l'entreprise et ses clients.

Rattaché(e) à la direction des opérations, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe qui conçoit aujourd'hui les équipements et dépose les brevets de l'entreprise.

Répartition indicative du temps : environ 70 à 80 % conception et développement, 20 à 30 % laboratoire (montage et validation de vos équipements).

Dans une structure à taille humaine, vous suivrez vos développements de la conception jusqu'aux tests, avant leur transfert à l'équipe de production.

Vos missions

Conception et développement d'équipements d’essais

  • Concevoir de nouvelles cellules et de nouveaux dispositifs d'essais, notamment pour des conditions de haute température et de haute pression.
  • Résoudre les problématiques techniques associées : instrumentation et capteurs, étanchéité, tenue en température et en pression.
  • Consulter les fournisseurs et sous-traitants, et suivre la fabrication des pièces.
  • Améliorer les équipements existants, notamment leur ergonomie et leur facilité d'utilisation en production.

Mise au point et validation

  • Monter les équipements développés et réaliser leurs tests de validation au laboratoire.
  • Interpréter les résultats expérimentaux et vérifier leur cohérence.
  • Transférer les équipements validés à l'équipe de production et l'accompagner dans leur prise en main.

Documentation et propriété intellectuelle

  • Rédiger la documentation technique, les rapports et les comptes-rendus, et les présenter, en français comme en anglais.
  • Participer à la veille technique et à la rédaction des documents de protection (brevets, enveloppes Soleau).

Vie du laboratoire

  • Comprendre les essais réalisés au laboratoire pour concevoir des équipements adaptés à leurs besoins.
  • Contribuer à l'activité du labo et à l'amélioration continue, dans le respect de la démarche qualité ISO 9001.

Requirements

Compétences techniques

  • Conception mécanique et maîtrise d'un logiciel de CAO.
  • Instrumentation, capteurs et techniques de mesure.
  • Compréhension des grandeurs physiques et physico-chimiques.
  • Rédaction technique et anglais professionnel, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.

Savoir-être

  • Autonomie et capacité à prendre en main un sujet de bout en bout.
  • Rigueur, notamment dans les phases d'essais.
  • Polyvalence et goût du concret : vous aimez concevoir autant que tester vous-même vos équipements.
  • Communication proactive, en particulier pour remonter et résoudre les difficultés rencontrées.
  • Envie d'apprendre et de s'investir dans une petite structure.

Formation et expérience

  • Diplôme d'ingénieur ou équivalent Bac +5 en génie mécanique, conception, instrumentation ou mesures physiques.
  • Expérience d'environ 5 ans en conception d'équipements, en bureau d'études ou en R&D. Les profils plus juniors avec une première expérience significative en conception seront étudiés.
  • Une expérience sur des équipements soumis à des contraintes de température ou de pression est un vrai plus.

Benefits

Vous rejoindrez une entreprise à taille humaine où chaque développement compte : vos équipements seront directement utilisés pour des projets de R&D menés pour des clients internationaux. Vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe dynamique et multiculturelle, sur des sujets techniques exigeants au service des énergies du sous-sol et de la transition énergétique.

🎯 MISSIONS

Veepee développe des algorithmes de pointe en matière de prévision et de tarification, qui constituent des priorités stratégiques pour l’entreprise.

Votre stage sera axé sur l’amélioration de la précision de nos modèles de tarification et de prévision, en travaillant sur des caractéristiques transversales.
Il existe de nombreuses pistes de recherche prometteuses pour améliorer nos algorithmes d’apprentissage automatique, notamment :

    • En collaboration étroite avec l’équipe de prévision et de tarification, vous explorerez, développerez des prototypes et comparerez différentes approches de modélisation avancées.
    Votre travail sera évalué à l’aide d’indicateurs de performance clés (KPI) clairs, lors d’évaluations hors ligne rigoureuses menées sur de grands ensembles de données.
    Dès qu’un modèle aura démontré de solides performances, vous aurez la possibilité de le déployer dans notre environnement MLOps cloud (Kubernetes, Docker, Airflow, MLflow, GitLab…).

  • Bac +5 en data sciences
  • Solides connaissances en Python

Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different:
 
- A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries
- A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth
- Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI
- A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently
 
Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 🪐
 
At Malt we believe that Ambition is the Way, so all lists of missions and responsibilities are non-exhaustive.

Explore your future career  🔭
 
As our new Key Account Manager, Public Sector, you will ensure the contract ownership, growth, and long-term success of strategic Public Sector accounts. Joining the Enterprise Account Management team, you will navigate the specificities of public procurement to drive local deployment and adoption. Your mission is to position Malt as a trusted partner while guaranteeing sustainable growth and alignment with our global enterprise strategy.
 

Key responsibilities ✨
  • Own the execution of account strategies, including governance, deployment, and renewal for Public Sector entities.
  • Drive new business acquisition by running structured prospection to detect new opportunities and securing high-stakes framework agreements.
  • Identify and engage key stakeholders such as HR, Procurement, and executive leaders within the public ecosystem.
  • Manage high-stakes negotiations and secure complex renewals or framework agreements.
  • Drive the expansion of Malt’s footprint by mapping new teams, departments, and use cases locally.
  • Ensure strict compliance with public sector constraints, including specific procurement processes and contractual rigor.
  • Articulate Malt’s value proposition and ROI to elevate conversations beyond price-driven discussions.
  • Maintain high discipline in CRM usage and MEDDIC data to provide reliable forecasting and portfolio visibility.

    • About you 🧑‍🚀
  • High-level education, ideally in Business Management, Political Science, or a related field.
  • Relevant experience (minimum 3+ years) in enterprise account management. Strong understanding of the public sector is a real asset.
  • Native level in French and Full professional English to manage both local stakeholders and internal global reporting.
  • Strong command of the MEDDIC sales methodology and CRM tools to track performance and mitigate risks.
  • Excellent negotiation skills with the ability to navigate complex budget cycles and procurement rules.

    • How to join the mission? 🚀
  • First call with our Talent Acquisition team, to better understand your background, aspirations, and answer any questions you may have. (30-45 minutes)

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Accountant (m/f/d) based in France.

As an Accountant, you will play a key role in maintaining accurate financial records and supporting the accounting operations of German entities within an international software group. You will oversee day-to-day accounting activities, contribute to month-end and year-end closing processes, and ensure compliance with German accounting standards and tax regulations. Working closely with the finance team, external tax advisors, and payroll providers, you will help deliver reliable financial reporting and maintain strong internal controls. You will also contribute to budgeting, variance analysis, and financial performance monitoring to support informed business decisions. This fully remote opportunity offers a hands-on environment where you can improve existing processes, bring structure to financial operations, and take ownership of meaningful responsibilities. It is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented accounting professional seeking to grow within an international, entrepreneurial, and collaborative team.


Accountabilities:
  • Manage day-to-day accounting activities for German legal entities, ensuring accurate, complete, and timely financial records.
  • Support month-end and year-end closing procedures, including journal entries, accounting adjustments, and financial analysis.
  • Prepare balance sheet reconciliations and support the review of account balances to ensure accuracy and completeness.
  • Follow up with vendors regarding missing invoices, prepare cost accruals, and contribute to profit and loss (P&L) reviews.
  • Process supplier payments and bank transfers, ensuring that the appropriate approvals and internal procedures are followed.
  • Reconcile intercompany transactions and investigate discrepancies to maintain consistent financial records across entities.

Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning
 
Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.
 
Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.
 
With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.
 
At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

The Data & Automations Team

The Data & Automations team builds and operates Pigment's internal data platform, and designs, implements, and maintains the intelligent automation solutions that rely on it. Together, they streamline business processes and enhance data-driven decision making: we empower product, business and corporate functions through technology integration, robust data architecture, and process optimization, enabling teams to focus on high-value activities while ensuring accuracy and scalability.

The data platform is the foundation of everything we deliver. It is a centralized, governed ecosystem that collects, stores, transforms, and serves data to internal consumers across Product, Go-To-Market (GTM), and General & Administrative (G&A) functions, providing a single source of truth for analytics, automations, and AI. Making it reliable, secure, cost-efficient, and scalable is at the core of our mission. The team also consolidates and orchestrates AI efforts across Pigment, from governance and enablement to building AI-powered solutions.

Our team tackles diverse challenges, from integrating finance and HR systems and streamlining employee lifecycle processes, to building pipelines that turn product usage and customer interactions into actionable insights for Finance or GTM teams. AI is now at the center of most of what we do with data: many of our pipelines feed LLM-powered solutions, and the quality, structure, and governance of our data architecture directly determine what these solutions can deliver.

The team is led by Pigment's Deputy CISO and works closely with the Security team: security and data governance are part of how we build, not an afterthought.

Role

As a Junior Data and Automations Engineer, you will contribute to the continued development of Pigment's data platform: ingestion pipelines, dbt models, orchestration, data quality, and the underlying cloud infrastructure. You will also build and maintain the data pipelines, automations, and AI projects that support our G&A (Finance, People, IT) and GTM (Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships) teams.

You will work closely with senior engineers, starting with well-scoped tasks and progressively taking ownership of small projects end to end, from requirements gathering to production monitoring. This role involves collaborating with a wide range of internal stakeholders and requires excellent communication skills in English (primarily) and French, verbal and written.

Tech environment

Our core stack relies on Google Cloud Platform, maintained with Terraform, with components including BigQuery, Cloud Run, and Cloud Composer (Airflow), as well as dbt, Fivetran, Hightouch, Elementary for data observability, and Python for integrations and automations. Our pipelines connect business systems such as Salesforce, NetSuite, our HRIS, Gong, or Slack, and feed Pigment applications used by our own business teams. We also build LLM-powered pipelines and use AI tools in our daily engineering work.

You will have the opportunity to learn and grow your skills across these technologies while making a meaningful impact on Pigment's operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

Under the supervision of the Data & Automations team's more senior members, you will participate in addressing the following topics.

Data Platform & Infrastructure:

  • Develop and maintain ingestion pipelines from APIs, databases, and SaaS tools, using Fivetran, Airflow, and Python
  • Build and maintain dbt models that turn raw data into clean, documented, and tested datasets
  • Contribute to the evolution of our orchestration, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code setup
  • Help improve data quality, observability, and alerting across the platform

G&A and GTM Data Pipelines & Automations:

  • Build pipelines and integrations that sync data between business systems (CRM, ERP, HRIS) through our data warehouse, including reverse ETL with Hightouch
  • Develop Python-based automations that remove manual work for teams such as Finance, People, IT, and Customer Success
  • Prepare reliable datasets for reporting and for the Pigment applications used by business teams

AI Projects:

  • Contribute to AI-powered solutions, such as LLM pipelines that extract, classify, and enrich unstructured data (call transcripts, messages, tickets)
  • Build the data foundations these projects rely on: AI-ready datasets, usage and observability data, evaluation data
  • Apply data architecture principles that make our data reliable, well-documented, and safely accessible for AI use cases (context, retrieval, access scoping)

Monitoring & Support:

  • Monitor pipelines and automations, troubleshoot incidents, and fix root causes
  • Document data models, pipelines, and processes for both technical and business readers

Collaboration & Learning:

  • Work with stakeholders - as diverse as Finance, People, Sales, and Product - to understand requirements and translate them into data solutions
  • Participate in code reviews and knowledge sharing sessions
  • Continuously expand your knowledge of data engineering, automation, and AI best practices

What you'll do
  • Under the supervision of the Business Automation team’s more senior members, you will participate in addressing the following topics.
    •  
    Automation Development:
  • Develop and maintain Python-based automations and solutions to streamline enterprise processes
  • Implement integrations between various systems and applications using APIs and other connection methods
  • Assist in maintaining CI/CD pipelines for automation projects
    •  
    Data Integration & Transformation:
  • Support the implementation of data pipelines that integrate data from various sources, including APIs, external databases, and third-party services
  • Assist in transforming raw data into clean and ready-to-use models using SQL and dbt
  • Collaborate on data quality monitoring and improvement initiatives
    •  
    Monitoring and Support:
  • Help implement monitoring for automation workflows and data pipelines
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues with existing automation solutions
  • Assist in documentation of systems, processes, and workflows
    •  
    Collaboration & Learning:
  • Work collaboratively with team members and stakeholders - as diverse as HR, Sales and Product Engineering - to understand requirements and implement effective solutions
  • Continuously expand knowledge of data engineering and automation best practices
  • Participate in code reviews and knowledge sharing sessions

    • Who you are

  • Technical skills

    The ideal candidate will possess most or all of the following qualifications. Hands-on experience through personal projects (share your GitHub account!), particularly contributions to open source initiatives, will be valued equally to professional and academic experience for this role.

  • Up to 3 years of relevant experience in data engineering, including apprenticeships, internships, and/or demonstrable personal projects
  • Strong SQL skills and understanding of data modeling concepts (e.g. layered or dimensional models)
  • Solid coding skills in Python
  • Understanding of ELT/ETL patterns, pipeline design, and data quality testing
  • Knowledge of version control systems (Git) and CI/CD concepts
  • Practical experience with a public cloud provider and a cloud data warehouse
  • Attention to detail and analytical problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify edge cases
  • Good understanding of AI and LLM principles, along with practical use of AI tools in your work
  • Excellent communication skills in both French and English, written and verbal

    • Soft skills

  • Problem-solving mindset with critical thinking about business processes
  • Strong communication abilities - translating technical concepts to non-technical audiences and active listening skills for accurately capturing business requirements
  • A natural curiosity, eagerness to learn, and comfort asking questions early rather than staying blocked are an absolute must
  • Bonus points: Basic project management capabilities - tracking tasks, managing timelines, and reporting progress

    • Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with dbt, Airflow, or Terraform
  • Exposure to ingestion and reverse ETL tools
  • Hands-on experience building LLM-powered pipelines or applications

  • Stock options to ensure you have a stake in Pigment's growth
  • The best health insurance with Alan Blue entirely free for you and your family 
  • Weekly Lunch and Lunch vouchers (Swile card) to cover your lunch breaks with total flexibility

  • Trust and flexible working hours
  • Along with one company offsite every year, we have brand new offices at the heart of major cities including New York, San Francisco, Toronto, Paris, and London
  • High-end equipment (based on stock/availability) to do your work in the best conditions

Location: You can apply to work at Qonto as long as you're living in (or willing to relocate to) either Germany, France, Italy, Serbia, Portugal, or Spain.
 
Mission
 
Join us as an iOS Engineer and help us build the most intuitive mobile banking experience for European businesses. You'll be crafting features that directly impact the daily financial operations of over 600,000 SMEs across Europe, making their business finance simpler and more efficient.
 
As an iOS Engineer at Qonto, you will:
 
• Craft cutting-edge financial features: Work on critical architectural and UI features that will directly impact our end users.
• Foster meaningful collaboration: Work closely with back-end teams, designers, and product managers to create a unified vision.
• Solve real-time challenges: Tackle real-time synchronization issues and spearhead new initiatives.
• Champion quality: Maintain an exceptional level of quality by implementing continuous refactoring and unit testing to consistently enhance the codebase.
 
What you can expect
 
• You'll be building for Europe's fastest-growing business banking market, with 600K+ clients across multiple countries and ambitious expansion plans
• Work in an environment that prioritizes quality, comprehensive code reviews, component approach and continuous refactoring as standard practice
• Contribute to a fully Swift-based app using MVP and Coordinators architecture, with modern CI/CD through GitHub, Firebase, and Bitrise
• Access to expert mentorship, Tech Weeklies & Monthlies, and conference opportunities to stay at the forefront of iOS development
 
Our methodology, the Qonto Way
We value upfront technical design, team reviews, and smart slicing, quality drives the velocity our customers need;
Our org assigns one team lead per project across stacks, giving your team a clear mission and full autonomy on how it operates;
Our lean toolbox, Kaizen, PDCA, lets you monitor and drive continuous improvement collaboratively with your peers and manager;
Each engineer gets access to Cursor or Copilot, and we want people who use AI to raise the bar, not just to go faster.
 
Your future team

As an iOS Engineer, you will join one of Qonto's squad teams, each organized around a clear project mission, with one team lead and full ownership of a product scope. You'll be part of a 140 mobile engineering community within a 500 Product Engineering department, working in focused teams of 5 to 10 people alongside Product, Design, and peers from Frontend and Backend.
 
Our stack & practices

Our app is 100% Swift, built on MVP & Clean Architecture with 35+ independent modules. We use the Coordinator pattern for scalability, and all new screens are built in SwiftUI (MVVM) with async/await — 80+ screens already migrated. Project generation and build optimization run on Tuist. CI/CD covers GitHub Actions, Bitrise, Firebase Test Lab, Sonar, and Fastlane.

We take technical excellence seriously: 30,000+ unit tests, 450+ snapshot tests, SwiftyMocky for mock generation, and LLMs integrated into our dev workflow. Our modular architecture (32 reusable modules + centralized design system) ensures fast builds, clear ownership, and safe iterations.

Want to know more about our mobile performance indicators? Read this.


About You
 
• iOS Expertise: Proven experience as a Mobile native engineer with strong Swift skills and deep understanding of the iOS ecosystem, SDK, and development lifecycle
• Quality-driven development: Strong commitment to best practices, including unit testing (XCTests, FBSnapshots), Clean code / SOLID principles, and organized workflows
• Problem-solving approach: Pragmatic and solution-oriented approach to engineering challenges, with ability to deliver tangible value in a fast-paced environment

At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers.

From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection.

As a certified B Corp, we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance.

Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries—from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches.

We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn, backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started!

The role 

We’re looking for a Senior Creative Designer to join our Brand team in Paris. You’ll help build a brand that is understood, remembered and trusted, making a powerful product feel simple, human and desirable. As part of our creative team, you’ll shape Brevo’s visual identity, content and digital presence across every channel and market. We believe great design starts with great thinking, so we question the brief, look for the sharpest idea and make sure it holds across every touchpoint.
 

Your impact at Brevo
  • Contribute to the evolution of Brevo's visual identity and brand guidelines, ensuring consistency across every touchpoint, from paid ads to event signage.
  • Design marketing and communication assets for product launches and campaigns, adapting concepts across channels, formats and markets (digital, social media, OOH, events, print).
  • Produce social-first content, including video, motion and short-form, for LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok and X, tailored to each platform's codes.
  • Build content plans that combine organic, paid and evergreen content, then measure performance and keep improving.
  • Translate complex product features into simple, engaging messages for different audiences and markets.
  • Partner with Growth, Product, Sales and Leadership to align creative work with business objectives.
  • Experiment with new formats and AI-powered creative tools, and bring what works into the team's workflow.

    • Who you are
  • Around 6 years of experience in creative, brand or content design, ideally in an agency, startup or SaaS/tech company, with a strong portfolio of brand, content and digital work.
  • You think before you design: you take the time to understand the product, challenge briefs constructively and turn complex ideas into clear visual stories.
  • You have a solid understanding of B2B communication, paid campaigns, social media best practices and storytelling.
  • You’re comfortable with AI creative tools (Midjourney, Runway, Kling, Claude…)
  • You're fluent in Figma (mandatory, including design systems) Adobe suite.
  • You're autonomous and organised, juggle several projects at once and take ownership from idea to execution.
  • You communicate in professional English (C1 or above).
  • Bonus points if you have B2C experience, speak French.
    • If you don't meet all the requirements above but believe this opportunity matches your expectations and experience, we still encourage you to apply!

    Why people love working at Brevo
  • A place to grow, together: Join an international team in a bright, collaborative office located in a vibrant neighborhood.
  • Practical perks for everyday balance: RTT days off, 50% public transport reimbursement, Sustainable Mobility Package (whether you ride a classic bike or go electric, we support your choice to commute greener) and daily Swile meal vouchers (€12.50/day).
  • Learning, every step of the way: Access to English classes and 155,000+ courses on Udemy, plus a strong internal culture of knowledge-sharing and support.
  • Flexible for life: A remote-friendly setup, budget to support your home workspace, and relocation assistance for international talents.
  • Wellbeing that works: Top-notch private healthcare (70% covered), 6-week second-parent leave, extra time off if your child is sick and needs you, and several services related to prevention, health and personal and professional well-being on Welii platform
  • A culture that cares: From inter-office trips to regular team events, there are plenty of ways to connect beyond your day-to-day. You'll also find active social, green, and LGBTQIA+ communities, plus Work Council benefits via Leeto, all here to support what matters to you, inside and outside of work.

  • Introductory TA call (30 min)
  • Meeting and Portfolio review with Rémi, Senior Brand & Com Director. (40 min)
  • Creative case study (4–5 hours of work) and presentation (45 min)
  • Final interview with our CMO (30 min)
  • Reference check

Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.

Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀 

About the Role

As part of the continued growth of our activities and the deployment of our photonic Quantum Processing Units (QPUs) to international customers, we are looking for a Technical Support & Operations Technician / Engineer to join our team.

You will contribute to the operational monitoring of Quandela's QPUs and other hardware products deployed at customer sites, ensuring their proper operation and supporting maintenance activities, both remotely and on site.

Working at the interface between Quandela's technical teams and system users, you will develop a broad understanding of our products, particularly the interactions between hardware equipment and software control interfaces. You will perform initial technical investigations when issues arise and involve the relevant technical experts when required.

The role combines technical support, maintenance, field interventions, training and continuous improvement in a complex and international technological environment.

Internal training will provide you with the specific knowledge required to understand our technology and systems. No previous experience in quantum computing is required.

As our support and maintenance activities are still being structured, you will also contribute to improving our processes, tools and operational methods.

Your Key Responsibilities:  

System operations & technical support

You will contribute to maintaining the operational performance and availability of QPUs and other hardware products deployed at customer sites.

    • Monitor the operation and performance of installed systems.
    • Analyse operational data and identify anomalies or performance degradation.
    • Perform initial technical investigations to characterise issues and help determine the appropriate resolution path.
    • Follow up on technical incidents and corrective actions with the relevant teams.
    • Maintain accurate technical records of systems and interventions.
    • Provide remote technical support to customers and trained personnel working on the systems.

Maintenance & customer-site interventions

You will contribute to the preparation and follow-up of preventive and corrective maintenance activities.

    • Track maintenance schedules and anticipate upcoming interventions.
    • Identify the resources, equipment, spare parts and technical expertise required for each intervention.
    • Perform diagnostic, maintenance and system recovery operations according to established procedures.
    • Support technicians and technical experts remotely or on site during interventions.
    • Perform functional checks and testing following maintenance activities.
    • Track completed actions, outstanding issues and upcoming maintenance requirements.

The role involves business travel within France and internationally, with frequency and duration depending on the needs of our installed systems.

User training & technical guidance

You will help customers and technical operators become increasingly autonomous in operating and maintaining our QPUs.

    • Train users and technical operators on routine QPU operation and maintenance activities.
    • Support users in operating the systems and their control interfaces.
    • Share best practices for operation, troubleshooting and maintenance.
    • Contribute to the creation and improvement of training materials and technical documentation.

Documentation & continuous improvement

You will ensure the traceability of technical operations and contribute to structuring our support and maintenance activities.

    • Prepare technical monitoring, intervention and maintenance reports.
    • Maintain up-to-date technical documentation for installed systems.
    • Contribute to writing and improving diagnostic, maintenance and operating procedures.
    • Capitalise on field experience to improve reliability and facilitate future interventions.
    • Contribute to implementing tools and methods for the structured monitoring of our installed systems.

Requirements

Education & experience

  • Associate's, Bachelor's or Master's degree in instrumentation, applied physics, optoelectronics or a related technical field.
  • The position is open to both experienced technicians and engineers with a strong interest in hands-on, operational activities.
  • Previous experience in operations, system integration, maintenance or technical support for complex systems is preferred.
  • Experience working in a multidisciplinary hardware/software environment is highly valued.
  • Experience supporting or maintaining technical equipment installed at customer sites would be an advantage.

Technical skills Required

  • Good understanding of complex technical systems combining hardware and software.
  • Knowledge of electronics, instrumentation and/or control systems.
  • Ability to analyse operational data and characterise technical issues.
  • Ability to perform diagnostic and maintenance operations according to established procedures.
  • Ability to identify and involve the appropriate technical experts when required.
  • Strong organisational skills and ability to rigorously track interventions, deadlines and outstanding actions.
  • Ability to follow, write and improve technical procedures.
  • Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken, as you will interact directly with international customers and colleagues, deliver training sessions and produce technical documentation.
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally.

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of optics, photonics and/or cryogenics.
  • Hands-on experience with optical systems, including basic optical alignment.
  • Experience operating or maintaining cryogenic systems.
  • Basic programming or scripting skills, particularly Python.
  • Experience maintaining scientific or industrial equipment.
  • Experience delivering technical training to users or operators.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • A hybrid work model (3 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris, 1 to 2 days remotely)
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview (30' - 45')
  • Hiring Manager Interview (45')
  • Use Case (a live use case or one to be prepared at home and presented afterward)
  • Meeting with the teams
  • 2 reference check
  • Offer

(This process is provided for guidance only and may evolve depending on the roles)

At Quandela, we believe that the strength of our team is the plurality of experiences, perspectives, and journeys. We are committed to building a respectful, inclusive, and welcoming work environment. All applications are welcome.

About Voodoo

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

Team

Our Corporate teams support the company’s performance and growth whilst putting people at the core of everything they do. As a French tech leader and global successful company, our Corporate teams are constantly looking for ways to innovate and increase organization efficiency to keep Voodoo ahead of the market. Voodoo’s Corporate function is composed of three teams: HR, Legal and Finance, working together to drive Voodoo’s success.

Role

We're looking for a Legal Counsel, AdTech Transactions to join our Legal team. In this role, you'll own the contracts and legal questions across Voodoo's advertising activity: selling ad inventory in our apps, buying user acquisition at scale, and the ad network we are now launching to connect third-party publishers and advertisers.

This position sits at the intersection of ad tech, commercial contracting, and data and privacy law, in a market where platform policies, ATT, GDPR, and consent frameworks change several times a year. Your work will directly shape how Voodoo monetizes its inventory, buys and measures user acquisition, grows its advertising network, and handles player data,while keeping us within legal and platform requirements and player expectations.

Your main responsibilities :

  • Own ad tech transactions end-to-end for Voodoo's games and apps portfolio: draft, negotiate and close agreements with mediation platforms, ad networks, exchanges and SSPs on the sell side, and with ad networks, DSPs, direct advertisers and rewarded platforms on the buy side,including the incentive and rebate agreements (bonuses, UA credits, payment terms), that drive the commercial terms..

  • Negotiate agreements with mobile measurement partners, attribution and analytics vendors, data providers and other partners

  • Advise on SDK integrations and data flows together with the Privacy team, so contracts match what the tech actually does

  • Build our advertising network's contract framework and advertising policies for third-party publishers, advertisers and programmatic partners; negotiate its infrastructure agreements and structure its commercial offers on the legal side

  • Manage partner disputes with networks, mediation platforms and other ad tech partners, including reporting discrepancies, invalid traffic (IVT) and compensation claims, from first analysis through negotiated resolution.

  • Track and apply platform policy changes and translate them into contract positions and business guidance

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Monetization, UA, Ad Network, Publishing and other product teams, serving as a trusted legal partner who helps the business move with speed and confidence

  • Build scalable legal infrastructure-templates, playbooks, fallback positions, contract tooling - that allows the business to operate efficiently as volume grows

Profile

  • 5-7 years of relevant legal experience, with meaningful time spent on ad tech and mobile/programmatic advertising, ideally in-house

  • Substantive familiarity with ad tech: you understand how mediation, in-app bidding, SDK-based data collection, attribution and device identifiers work at a technical level - not just a conceptual one - and you know who does what along the supply chain

  • Transactional experience: you've negotiated agreements with companies across the advertising ecosystem, ideally on both the publisher and advertiser side

  • Privacy law fluency: you handle the privacy side of a deal as comfortably as the commercial side

  • Industry standards: you know IAB terms and the TCF inside out

  • Risk tolerance and business judgment: you're comfortable making calls in the absence of perfect information, offering clear and concise risk framing that avoids unnecessary stalling of the business. You operate like a business partner, not outside counsel

  • Strong communication skills: you translate complex legal requirements into plain language for technical and non-technical stakeholders alike, and you're comfortable presenting your views succinctly and with confidence

  • Autonomy and initiative: you take ownership of your portfolio, identify problems before they escalate, and propose solutions rather than waiting to be directed

  • Master 2 in business law, IT/digital law or IP law from a French university or equivalent; avocat or in-house juriste profiles are equally welcome; an LL.M. or study abroad experience is a plus

  • Full professional English required

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on experience

  • Swile Lunch voucher

  • Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)

  • Premium healthcare coverage with SideCare, 100% covered for you and your family

  • Wellness activities in our Paris office

data.description:
About EH Group Engineering

EHG is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To help bring this vision to life, we are looking for a Senior Control Engineer to coordinate our efforts in designing control strategies for containerized systems integrating our fuel cell technology alongside equipment such as gas reformers, batteries, and climate control units. You will coordinate the control team and play a key role in shaping how these complex, multi-equipment systems operate safely and efficiently in the field.

Based in the US? You’re welcome to apply. This is an on-site role in Nyon, Switzerland. We ask that you relocate within 3 months of starting, and we’ll support you with a relocation package.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate the control engineering activities and define the control architecture and technical roadmap for our fuel cell and containerized power systems

  • Develop control strategies, models and algorithms for test-benches, fuel cell system and containerized power supply systems using Matlab/Simulink and Siemens PLCs

  • Coordinate the transition of prototype control algorithms from Simulink to industrial-quality code in TIA Portal Step 7

  • Implement, tune and validate controllers for thermal, air, fuel and power subsystems

  • Define and own control requirements, state machines and safety/diagnostic logic

  • Drive the continuous improvement (performance, efficiency and robustness) of our products

  • Define and oversee model-in-the-loop (MIL) testing and validation procedures

  • Manage the complete software life cycle, from requirements through release and maintenance, including dataset management

  • Establish coding standards, conduct code reviews and ensure compliance with industrial and certification requirements

  • Coordinate and develop the control team, including task planning and prioritization

  • Act as the main control interface with embedded, test and electrical engineering, as well as external partners and suppliers

 

Skills and Experience Required:

  • BSc/MSc in control, electrical, mechatronic or automation engineering is mandatory

  • Minimum 7 years of experience in control engineering, including at least 2 years in a technical lead or senior role

  • Skill 1 : Strong experience in process control engineering, particularly with containerized power supply systems; knowledge of programming and implementing safety PLCs is a strong plus

  • Skill 2 : Strong experience with TIA Portal (Step 7, WinCC, Test Suite), with the ability to structure code to industrial standards and meet certification requirements

  • Experience with functional safety (e.g. IEC 61508, ISO 13849), including SIL/PL determination and implementation of safety functions

  • Experience across the complete V-model development cycle, including hazard and risk assessment, requirements definition, safety requirements specification (SRS), verification and validation, and dataset management

  • Experience with stationary and maritime power applications, with a focus on the US and EU markets and their respective standards and certification requirements

  • Proven team player, with the ability to:
    (i) Coordinate and mentor the control team by clearly explaining your code and helping the team adopt robust industrial methods: you will take the responsibility in developing Skill 1 and Skill 2 across the team
    (ii) Collaborate effectively within interdisciplinary teams

  • Solid knowledge of control theory, state machines and system identification

  • Strong experience with MATLAB/Simulink and model-based design is a plus

  • Professional working language is in English.

     

Start date: Immediately

data.description:
About EHG

EH Group (EHG) is a rapidly growing fuel cell power platform delivering onsite power to AI data centers, defense, and industry. Our fuel-agnostic proton exchange membrane (PEM) systems scale from kW-scale units to GW-scale power plants, and we design, manufacture, and deploy them for customers worldwide.

Founded in Switzerland, EHG is now expanding into the United States, fueled by exponential AI data center power demand and a soon-to-be-announced major investment round. This is a defining, high-growth chapter for the company.

 

The opportunity

We're hiring a Quality Manager to own a single quality system across both of our production streams — our established MW-scale facility in Nyon, Switzerland and our new US operation in Houston, Texas.

You'd be based in Nyon, where our production and process knowledge sits today, and own quality for the US operation as it stands up. The requirement is explicit: quality must be identical at both sites. Same specifications, same control plans, same acceptance criteria, same records. A customer taking delivery of a system should not be able to tell which site built the stack inside it, and our certification and warranty position depends on being able to demonstrate that.

Our customers are data center operators, defense programs, and industrial sites where reliability is the product. In your first year you'd harmonize our quality management system across both entities, establish controls in Houston that match those proven in Nyon as manufacturing technology transfers, build supplier quality alongside Supply Chain for a shared global supply base, and support certification of our systems for both European and US markets.

Location & travel: Nyon-based. Regular travel to Houston is expected as the US operation stands up, along with travel to supplier and partner sites in Europe and the US.

 

What you'll own

  • One quality management system across both entities — a common QMS covering Nyon and Houston, including the path to ISO 9001 certification in the US and alignment with what is already established in Switzerland.

  • Equivalence between sites. A single set of product specifications, control plans, inspection criteria, and acceptance standards, with a defined process for how any change is applied at both sites rather than one.

  • In-process quality for fuel cell stack production at both locations, including the process controls that matter most in stack assembly — cleanliness and contamination control, leak testing, torque and compression control, and alignment.

  • Supplier quality for a shared global supply base, working with Supply Chain on qualification, audits, first article inspection, part submission, and ongoing performance, with one qualification standard regardless of which site a supplier serves.

  • Quality oversight of contract manufacturing and assembly partners building balance of plant and containerized systems on our behalf in both regions — audits, quality agreements, source inspection, and acceptance criteria.

  • Nonconformance and corrective action across both sites, including NCR and CAPA processes and structured problem solving, with findings at one site systematically applied at the other.

  • Traceability and product records — a common lot genealogy model from raw material through stack serial to delivered system, and the test and inspection data that supports warranty, certification, and customer acceptance, held consistently across both entities.

  • Certification across regions, working with external certification partners on the standards applicable to stationary hydrogen power systems in Europe and the US, authority having jurisdiction approvals, and marine classification where relevant.

  • Quality culture on both floors, including operator training, work instruction discipline, and establishing the habits in Houston that are already proven in Nyon, as US headcount grows quickly.

  • Building the US quality capability, defining what needs to sit on the ground in Houston versus what is run centrally from Nyon, and recruiting into it as volumes grow.

 

What we're looking for

Core experience

  • Owning quality across more than one manufacturing site, ideally in more than one country, with a demonstrated ability to hold two sites to genuinely the same standard from a distance.

  • Establishing or substantially rebuilding a quality function, including authoring a quality management system rather than administering an existing one.

  • Hands-on in-process and incoming quality in a production setting, with real familiarity with control plans, inspection methods, measurement systems, and process capability.

  • Supplier quality experience, including auditing suppliers and holding them to standard.

  • Structured problem solving and root cause analysis, with a track record of permanently closing out recurring defects.

  • Working knowledge of product certification processes and the evidence they require, ideally in energy, power equipment, or another regulated product category. Exposure to both European and US regimes is a strong advantage.

  • The judgment to know which controls are essential at low volume and which can wait, and the confidence to hold a quality position under schedule pressure.

  • Comfort working across time zones and influencing a site you are not physically based at, including building quality capability remotely.

Especially compelling

  • Fuel cell, battery cell, or similar electrochemical assembly experience.

  • Experience with cleanliness-critical or contamination-sensitive assembly processes.

  • Experience supporting a technology transfer between sites or countries, and establishing quality at the receiving end.

  • Experience qualifying and auditing contract manufacturers or system integrators.

  • Startup or scale-up experience as an early hire during hyper-growth.

  • Experience working between Europe and the US, and with US codes and certification practice in particular. French is useful but not required.

 

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation and meaningful equity, calibrated to the market and discussed directly with you.

  • Relocation support to Nyon, Switzerland.

  • The opportunity to build EHG's global quality function during a defining phase of hyper-growth.

Note: Swiss work authorization or eligibility is required for this role, along with the ability to travel to the United States.

 

EH Group is an equal opportunity employer. We value a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

About Enact

The next defining technological breakthrough will be in the physical world. We stand at a historical inflection point: bringing general-purpose intelligence into robotics.

At Enact we rethink the entire robotic tech stack from model architectures and data pipelines, to the actuators and sensors that feed the model. Pushing beyond pure vision and language approaches, we build a proprioceptive nerve system, and the cortex that makes sense of it, to solve dexterity through whole-body force-awareness and deploy robots for thousands of tasks in industry and beyond.

We are shaping a company where brilliant and unconventional people thrive together on solving the hardest challenges of our time. We are truth seekers. We reason from first principles, test our beliefs against reality, and trust that the best ideas can come from anyone. We move fast. We care deeply about our work and colleagues and are driven by passion to change the status quo.

If this resonates, we're excited to hear from you.

In This Role You Will

  • Design, integrate and test the electromechanical systems at the core of our dexterous robots: actuator modules, joints, and end-effectors, sensors, PCBs, and cable harnesses into compact, reliable units for high-DoF robotics

  • Bring hardware to life: lead system assembly & bring-up, debug across mechanics, electronics, and firmware, and work with controls & AI engineers to build a fully vertically integrated manipulation system

  • Develop & build automated test setups to validate performance, durability, and reliability, and take systems from prototype to series production

What We're Looking For

  • Degree (BSc/MSc/PhD) in mechatronics, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related field

  • Visa sponsorship & relocation benefits to hire the best in the world

data.description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the Role

We're looking for a hands-on scientist-engineer to help build our next-generation DNA synthesis platform, enabling high-throughput, cost-effective production of large and diverse DNA libraries. You'll work at the intersection of chemistry, materials science, bioengineering, and hardware development, designing and building prototypes, running experiments, and optimizing processes to turn new synthesis technologies into reliable, scalable production systems.

DNA synthesis is a fundamental part of our protein engineering platform. We're developing new approaches to dramatically increase synthesis throughput while reducing cost and turnaround time.

You'll work closely with our scientific and engineering teams to develop and prototype new DNA synthesis technologies. Your focus will be on translating scientific concepts into working hardware and experimental systems, designing and building prototypes, testing different approaches, and continuously improving their performance.

This is a highly hands-on, interdisciplinary role combining experimental science with practical engineering. You'll take ownership of prototype development, experimental validation, and process optimization, helping move promising technologies from early concepts to reliable, scalable systems.

We're looking for someone who enjoys building things, solving technical problems, and working across disciplines. You don't need to be an expert in DNA synthesis, but you should have strong scientific fundamentals, an engineering mindset, and experience turning ideas into working prototypes.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and test prototypes for next-generation DNA synthesis technologies.

  • Translate scientific and technical requirements into practical engineering designs and experimental setups.

  • Scope and evaluate different technical approaches, components, materials, and equipment for prototype development.

  • Develop and optimize the chemistry, materials, and processes underlying the synthesis platform.

  • Design and execute experiments to characterize performance, identify limitations, and improve reliability.

  • Work closely with mechanical, electronics, software, and automation engineers to develop integrated experimental systems.

  • Troubleshoot complex technical problems across chemistry, hardware, and process engineering.

  • Develop analytical methods and quality control strategies to measure performance and guide optimization.

  • Help scale successful prototypes into robust, reproducible systems suitable for routine production.

  • Work with external suppliers and engineering partners to source components, evaluate technologies, and accelerate development.

What We're Looking For

  • A strong background in chemical engineering, chemistry, materials science, bioengineering, mechanical engineering, or a related field.

  • Hands-on experience designing, building, and testing experimental setups, prototypes, or laboratory equipment.

  • Strong understanding of chemistry, materials, or process engineering, with the ability to apply these fundamentals to practical engineering challenges.

  • Experience developing and optimizing experimental processes, including systematic troubleshooting and performance characterization.

  • Comfortable working across hardware and experimental science, translating scientific requirements into practical engineering solutions.

  • Experience selecting components, evaluating technical trade-offs, and iterating on prototype designs.

  • Strong experimental skills, including designing experiments, analyzing data, and making decisions based on results.

  • Independent, resourceful, and comfortable working on open-ended technical problems.

  • A practical, hands-on approach to engineering, with a focus on building, testing, and improving systems rather than purely theoretical development.

  • Experience with DNA or oligonucleotide synthesis, including chemical or enzymatic approaches, is a plus.

  • Experience with solid-phase synthesis, surface chemistry, or chemical process development is a plus.

  • Familiarity with microfluidics, high-throughput dispensing, or array-based technologies is a plus.

  • Experience with laboratory automation, instrumentation, or custom hardware development is a plus.

  • Experience with CAD, electronics, fluidics, or mechanical prototyping is a plus.

  • Experience scaling experimental technologies from proof of concept to production is a plus.

  • Programming and data analysis experience, particularly in Python, is a plus.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the Role

This is not a lab technician position. This is a senior scientist who owns assay quality, data QC and controls, and production troubleshooting across the entire experimental pipeline.

The production team runs 150+ experiments per month across expression, BLI, SPR, thermostability, and enzyme activity. When something goes wrong (failed expression, anomalous binding data, instrument artifacts), this person diagnoses the root cause and fixes it. As the assay and instrumentation portfolio expands, this person translates new R&D methods into production-ready protocols, builds robust methods that junior technicians can execute reliably, and designs comprehensive controls that enable automated QC and data processing.

This is a player-coach position. You will still run experiments personally, especially as you integrate into the lab, but you will also elevate the whole team's capabilities.

What You'll Do

  • Troubleshoot production failures across the full pipeline. A batch of proteins isn't expressing: is it the construct design, the expression system, or the media? BLI sensorgrams look noisy: is it the sensor tips, the sample prep, or an instrument issue? You figure it out, fix it, and make the cause easier to identify next time.

  • Develop and document SOPs for new assays as the portfolio expands. Take methods from the R&D team and make them production-ready: robust, reproducible, and executable by junior technicians without hand-holding.

  • Mentor a growing production team. Set quality standards, review data, train new hires, and build a culture where people flag problems early instead of hiding them.

  • Work at the intersection of biology, automation, and QC. Collaborate with researchers, laboratory technicians, and automation engineers on protocol optimization for work cells, and with software on LabOS protocol integration.

  • Own the relationship between assay science and throughput. The easy version of every assay doesn't scale, and the scalable version often sacrifices quality. You find the right tradeoff.

What We're Looking For

  • Deep hands-on expertise in protein production: expression (E. coli, mammalian, cell-free), purification (IMAC, SEC), and biophysical characterization (BLI and SPR at minimum). This isn't negotiable. You need to have done this work yourself, at volume.

  • PhD in protein biochemistry, biophysics, or structural biology, plus 3-5 years in a production or development role at a CRO, foundry, or high-throughput lab. Academic postdocs count if the work was high-throughput and production-oriented.

  • Experience with high-throughput workflows. You're comfortable with 96-well plates and liquid handlers, not just single-column purifications. You've optimized protocols for scale, not just for one perfect result.

  • Mentorship mindset. You've managed or trained junior scientists before. You enjoy teaching and get satisfaction from watching your team grow.

  • Troubleshooting instinct. When data looks wrong, your first impulse is to understand why, not to rerun the experiment and hope it works.

  • Quality-obsessed but pragmatic. You care deeply about data quality, but you also understand that production has deadlines and sometimes "good enough" is the right call.

  • Bridge between R&D and production. You can speak both languages: the exploratory mindset of research and the reproducibility demands of production.

  • Location: Lausanne, Switzerland (on-site)

  • Type: Full time

  • Start date: ASAP

data.description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the Role

Our lab in Lausanne runs thousands of constructs a week through automated workcells, liquid handlers, and binding instruments. That only works if the instruments are calibrated, the buffers are made, the stock is where the system says it is, and the bench is ready when the scientists arrive. You are the person who makes sure it is.

You'll own the day-to-day upkeep of our automation and instruments, run buffer and reagent production, keep the lab clean, safe, and stocked, and lead the rollout of new inventory management and lab operations processes across the lab. This is a hands-on, in-the-lab role, working closely with our Lab Manager, the Lab Operations team, and the scientists whose experiments depend on you getting it right.

What You'll Do

  • Run daily and weekly calibration of our Hamilton liquid handling systems.

  • Calibrate and maintain key instruments, including the Echo and pH meters.

  • Look after the SPR system: buffer bottle changes, rinsing, and routine upkeep.

  • Take ownership of our automated workcells and keep them clean, organized, and calibrated.

  • Prepare buffers, reagents, and reaction mixes according to established SOPs. Run weekly buffer production and handle ad-hoc requests from the team.

  • Lead the rollout of new inventory management and lab operations processes across the lab, and help design and improve them as the lab scales.

  • Organize fridges and storage, run inventory, and keep consumables, glassware, and bench supplies stocked so experiments never stall.

  • Keep benches and shared spaces clean, clear, and ready for work every day.

  • Manage hazardous and biohazardous waste disposal (including broken glass and sharps), waste sorting, recycling, and general waste removal in line with safety regulations.

  • Run the lab dishwasher and make sure clean glassware is always available.

  • Plan and document scheduled deep cleans and preventive maintenance.

What We're Looking For

  • Laboratory apprenticeship (CFC Laborant/in), BSc in a relevant field, or an equivalent lab technician qualification.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Precision in following and executing protocols and SOPs.

  • A service mindset. You enjoy making other people's work easier.

  • Comfortable with routine, with an eye for ways to improve it.

  • Calm and reliable in a fast-paced, high-throughput environment.

  • Experience with lab automation or liquid handling systems (Hamilton, Echo, or similar) is a plus.

  • Experience with inventory or LIMS tools is a plus.

  • Proficiency in English and French is a plus. Many of our vendors and delivery services operate in French.

About the Role

This is a hands-on research role in our biology and production team. You'll work on the science that underpins everything Adaptyv does: developing and optimizing protein expression systems, running molecular biology workflows, and pushing the boundaries of what we can produce and characterize at scale.

We express proteins at high volume across cell-free and cell-based systems, run DNA synthesis and assembly at high throughput, and characterize binding, stability, and function using BLI, SPR, and enzymatic assays.

What you'll do

  • Develop and optimize protein expression workflows - cell-free expression (PURE, lysate-based), E. coli, and potentially mammalian systems. Troubleshoot when proteins don't express, misfold, or aggregate.

  • Design and execute DNA synthesis and assembly protocols: PCR, Golden Gate, Gibson. Improve yield, fidelity, and throughput.

  • Develop new assays or adapt existing ones for the platform - thermostability, developability, enzyme activity, or whatever the next customer need demands.

  • Run experiments yourself. This is not a project management role. You'll be at the bench doing molecular biology, analyzing data, and iterating on protocols.

  • Work with the automation team to translate your methods into automated workflows. You develop the protocol that works; they make the robots run it.

  • Analyze experimental data, identify failure modes, and improve methods systematically. When 20% of constructs in a batch fail to express, you figure out why.

What we're looking for

  • MSc or PhD in molecular biology, biochemistry, bioengineering, or a related field. Hands-on depth matters most - years at the bench doing real molecular biology counts more than the degree title.

  • Practical protein expression and purification skills. You've expressed recombinant proteins and know what it takes to get them soluble, folded, and functional.

  • Experience with DNA synthesis, cloning, or assembly methods (PCR, Golden Gate, Gibson). High-throughput experience is a plus.

  • Comfortable with data analysis - you interpret chromatograms, binding curves, and expression gels without hand-holding.

  • Rigorous experimentalist. You keep detailed notes, design proper controls, and understand why reproducibility matters when you're running hundreds of experiments a month.

  • Interested in automation. You don't need to program robots, but you should want your protocols to become automated workflows rather than staying manual forever.

  • Independent and resourceful. You troubleshoot using literature, first principles, and experimentation - not by waiting for someone to tell you what to try next.

Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

We are looking for a Trust & Safety Product Manager to own the product and technical delivery of our compliance and safety initiatives across our platforms.

You will turn safety requirements into effective product features, moderation capabilities, third-party integrations, and measurable improvements. Working closely with Compliance, Engineering, AI/ML, Product, and Customer Support, you will help us identify risks earlier, build safeguards into new features, and continuously improve how our safety systems perform.

This is a newly created role within our Product team, working directly with our CTO, Michael Monin and our Legal & Safety Lead, Maxwelle Sokol. You will have significant ownership from the outset and the opportunity to shape how the safety product function develops as the company continues to grow.

Our platform serves adults and permits lawful adult content. We are looking for someone who can navigate sensitive, context-dependent issues thoughtfully, protecting users and enforcing clear boundaries without unnecessarily restricting legitimate expression.

Here’s what you can expect:

Key Responsibilities

  • Safety & legal product strategy and delivery. Translate safety policies, legal requirements (e.g., in online safety and AI-specific laws such as the EU AI Act), incident findings, and user feedback into clear product requirements, acceptance criteria, and engineering work. Drive initiatives from problem definition through implementation, testing, launch, and ongoing improvement.

  • Internally developed moderation technologies. Own the product side of improvements to our in-house moderation systems, including our proprietary LLM technology EverGuard. Partner with Engineering and AI/ML teams on, e.g., detection capabilities, moderation rules and thresholds, and appropriate interventions across user inputs and AI-generated outputs.

  • Third-party safety partnerships and integrations. Lead the technical and product lifecycle of third-party safety partnerships, from identifying needs and evaluating providers to implementation, testing, rollout, and ongoing performance management.

  • Safety dashboards, monitoring, and quality assurance. Establish dashboards and a recurring QA that help us proactively identify emerging issues, prevent harmful content, and ensure that our T&S measures are working as intended.

  • Red teaming and adversarial testing. Own our testing for how moderation systems and product safeguards respond to deliberate misuse and difficult edge cases. Track findings through remediation, retesting, and closure—not just delivery of a report.

  • Trust and safety reviews for new features.
